name: Hariom Joshi
tagline: AWS · Infrastructure as Code · Java · Python
positioning: I own the AWS estate behind a COBOL-mainframe-to-cloud modernisation programme for a Fortune 500 US investment management client. Roughly 80% of the resource footprint across dev, UAT and production is mine to define — CloudFormation stacks, ECS Fargate services, Aurora and Redshift, DMS migrations and the GitHub Actions pipelines that ship them — alongside the Java 17 and Python services replacing the batch workloads we migrate off the mainframe.
philosophy: Infrastructure goes into a template before it goes into an account. Anything built with a console click has to be rebuilt with a console click at 3am, so it gets written down, reviewed, and shipped through the same pipeline as the application code.

projects.name: spender-guardian
projects.description: AWS cost-visibility tooling: pulls spend per account and surfaces what moved, so a bill that jumps is traceable to the resource behind it rather than to a monthly total.

projects.name: infant-emotion-detection
projects.description: Real-time emotion detection over audio and image input using a CNN, reaching 97% classification accuracy, with REST APIs triggering downstream actions on detected state.

experience.title: Software Engineer
experience.context: Cloud modernisation programme for a Fortune 500 US investment management client — migrating COBOL mainframe batch workloads to Java and Python on AWS. 20-engineer engagement.
bullets: Own ~80% of the AWS resource estate across dev, UAT and production — EC2, ECS Fargate, Lambda, S3, Aurora, Redshift, KMS, Secrets Manager, Step Functions and EFS — including least-privilege IAM policies, secrets rotation, and the S3 lifecycle rules that brought spend down.
Cut EC2 provisioning from 15–20 minutes to under 2 minutes — around 90% — by profiling and removing non-essential userdata bootstrap commands, shortening every job-execution cycle in the environment.
Authored and maintain 15–20 CloudFormation stacks that provision the whole environment, and 30–40 GitHub Actions pipelines publishing build artifacts to JFrog Artifactory.
Built the Java 17 / Spring Boot services running on ECS Fargate and the Python services on Lambda behind batch jobs that process 200,000–500,000 customer records per peak run.

Delivered an AWS Storage Gateway file share end to end for controlled external access to S3 objects — ServiceNow change requests, Active Directory group provisioning, SailPoint role design and the network configuration behind it.

experience.title: Web Developer Intern
experience.context: Internal tooling for candidate assessment — a browser extension and the cloud APIs behind it.
bullets: Built a Chrome extension with React and Node.js that automated candidate monitoring, removing the manual proctoring effort it replaced.
Wrote the cloud interaction APIs behind it for real-time screen capture and secure storage.
